account_card_days_check.name: account_card_days_check
account_card_days_check.value: ("account"."type" = 'credit_card' and ("account"."closing_day" is null or "account"."closing_day" between 1 and 31) and ("account"."due_day" is null or "account"."due_day" between 1 and 31)) or ("account"."type" <> 'credit_card' and "account"."closing_day" is null and "account"."due_day" is null)

category_group_required_check.name: category_group_required_check
category_group_required_check.value: ("category"."type" = 'expense' and "category"."group_id" is not null) or ("category"."type" = 'income' and "category"."group_id" is null)

movement_category_required_check.name: movement_category_required_check
movement_category_required_check.value: ("movement"."type" in ('income', 'expense') and "movement"."category_id" is not null) or ("movement"."type" = 'transfer' and "movement"."category_id" is null)

recurring_month_check.name: recurring_month_check
recurring_month_check.value: ("recurring"."frequency" = 'yearly' and "recurring"."month_of_year" is not null and "recurring"."month_of_year" between 1 and 12) or ("recurring"."frequency" <> 'yearly' and "recurring"."month_of_year" is null)

recurring_amount_check.name: recurring_amount_check
recurring_amount_check.value: ("recurring"."amount_mode" = 'fixed' and "recurring"."amount_minor" is not null and "recurring"."amount_minor" > 0) or ("recurring"."amount_mode" = 'variable' and ("recurring"."amount_minor" is null or "recurring"."amount_minor" > 0))
